findings.title: Two desks grade England -9.5 High while the only verified England result is an 18-point defeat
findings.text: The v3 desk and the 6a081cf6 strict-band desk both publish 'England -9.5' as a High-confidence selection for the RLWC2026 Round 2 match against France. The IRL's own match record for Round 1, read this session, states England lost 12-30 to Tonga at HBF Park on 17 October - conceding two tries in three minutes to turn a 10-6 lead into 22-6 against them. No official world-ranking pair or France Round 1 result was published, so repository rule 4 refuses the strength edge: this desk caps that fixture at Low and publishes no price.

findings.title: Tonga -2.5 graded High on one-sided evidence
findings.text: 'Tonga -2.5' is a High selection in the v3 and 6a081cf6 desks. Tonga's 30-12 Round 1 win over England is verified on the IRL match record, but Lebanon's Round 1 result against Papua New Guinea was not published on any official page read this session, so only one side of that tie carries a sourced form input. Rule 4 caps it at Low here. A related flag from session 6a081cf6 (F-6A-02, NRL late mail ruling Isaiya Katoa out) is also not reflected in the IRL squad list read this session, which names Lehi Hopoate, Sione Katoa, Tolu Koula and Saia Katoa among others.

findings.title: Six datasets describe overlapping windows with different row counts
findings.text: Fixture counts per desk: root=134, v3=0, 984d417f=145, 7a5b5360=32, 6a081cf6=9, f71557b5=72. They are not reconcilable by row count alone because each desk harvested at a different time and applied a different expiry rule. There is still no canonical dataset; this desk adds a seventh namespace and edits none of the others. Whoever integrates should pick one canonical board and archive the rest, which is what branch arena/26be136b-olbg1 has started doing with archive/root-20261021/.

This session renumbered its claim to T50 / section 37 and did not touch root index.html, scripts/build_site.py, scripts/validate.py or README.md; the navigation request is logged in COORDINATION.md section 4 instead.

findings.title: The generated root navigation is hand-patched, so a rebuild drops desks
findings.text: index.html carries a hand-added 'Latest snapshot: 22 October re-verified board' banner inside a file that scripts/build_site.py generates. Session 2ca35f17 logged the same problem for the 7a5b5360 companion link and fixed that one in the generator. The v3 banner is still only in the output. Any desk added by editing index.html directly - including this one, had it been allowed to - will vanish on the next root rebuild.
